title: The third unit in the adjoint tower of group involutions
summary: The functor $G\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}(C_2,G)$ determines an adjoint tower through successive Eilenberg--Moore comparison functors. We prove that the unit of the third adjunction need not be an isomorphism, answering a question of Bergman. For the generalized dihedral group $H=(C_4\times C_4)\rtimes C_2$, with inversion action, we compute $F_3V_3H\cong H\times C_2$, with counit the first projection.
